content: प्रभेदः .²1 Splitting, cleaving, opening. .²2 Division, separation. .²3 The flowing of rut or ichor from the temples of an elephant; बभूव तेनातितरां सुदुःसहः कटप्रभेदेन करीव पार्थिवः <ls>R. 3. 37</ls>. .²4 Difference, distinction. .²5 A kind or sort. .²6 The place of origin (as of a river); शोणस्य नर्मदायाश्च प्रभेदे कुरुनन्दन <ls>Mb. 3. 85. 9</ls>.
